Layout Archetype: Pattern 4 (Specialized Stats Grid & Live Technician Status)
Features & Scope: Real-time B2B performance overview. Tracks daily sales, matching gaps, active bookings status, online company technicians, and unassigned queue count.
UX/UI Design & Flows: 1. Merchant logs in and views metrics panels. | 2. Stepper indicates unassigned task alerts. | 3. Clicking metric redirects to operations dispatch center.
Interactive Buttons & Controls: - 'Refresh Indicators' (re-queries endpoints) | - 'View Dispatch Center' link cards | - KPI summaries

Features & Scope: Deep visual graphing of sales splits, completed checkouts, and customer retention metrics.
UX/UI Design & Flows: 1. Date filters load corresponding datasets. | 2. Recharts render line/bar graphs showing revenue changes. | 3. Hover displays tooltips detailing exact coordinates.
Interactive Buttons & Controls: - 'Date range picker' calendar select | - Chart type toggles | - 'Export CSV' button

Features & Scope: Form to compile service performance reports and customer growth logs on web.
UX/UI Design & Flows: 1. Merchant selects parameters. | 2. Clicks build. | 3. Export PDF/CSV generates records.
Interactive Buttons & Controls: - 'Compile Report' button | - 'Export PDF' button

Features & Scope: Tracks B2B logs of bookings matches, payouts approvals, and dispute alert messages.
UX/UI Design & Flows: 1. Grid renders list of notifications. | 2. Row action clears or dismisses single notification. | 3. Clear all clears current feed.
Interactive Buttons & Controls: - 'Clear All' button | - 'Dismiss Notification' row buttons | - Filters

Features & Scope: Chat dashboard for client support and technician allocations coordination.
UX/UI Design & Flows: 1. Left panel lists chats. | 2. Row click opens right side chat room panel to send text/images.
Interactive Buttons & Controls: - Search chats input | - Send message icon | - Upload file button

Features & Scope: Command console displaying live technician pins, ongoing path coordinates, unassigned job flags, and task matching rules.
UX/UI Design & Flows: 1. Left panel maps list of unassigned booking tags. | 2. Right side maps OpenStreetMap/Google Map displaying technician markers (Green = Available, Orange = Busy). | 3. Selecting 'Auto Match' executes dispatch engine script. Clicking technician marker permits manual override dispatching.
Interactive Buttons & Controls: - 'Auto Match' action button | - 'Manual Dispatch' selector select list | - Map zoom slider controls | - Technician filter toggles

Features & Scope: Unified company bookings ledger. Separates tabs: Need Assignment 🔴, In Progress, Scheduled, etc.
UX/UI Design & Flows: 1. Renders DataGrid list. Filters sort by status tabs. | 2. Clicking row slides out BookingDrawer showing checkpoints progress. | 3. Clicking 'Full Details' routes to bookings/[id] detail page.
Interactive Buttons & Controls: - Search query bar | - Status filter tabs ('Pending', 'Assigned', 'Need Assignment') | - 'Create Booking' button (opens CreateBookingDrawer) | - Row components

Features & Scope: Full-screen booking dashboard displaying assigned staff GPS locations, checklists, invoices, customer messages, and proof photos.
UX/UI Design & Flows: 1. Left panel details stepper checkpoints and maps path. | 2. Right panel maps action buttons. | 3. Saving status triggers real-time socket events.
Interactive Buttons & Controls: - 'Accept Booking' / 'Decline Booking' buttons | - 'Assign Technician' dropdown select | - 'Cancel Job' warning button | - 'Message Customer' link anchor

Features & Scope: Manage shifts parameters and schedule technician workloads in a week grid calendar.
UX/UI Design & Flows: 1. Renders calendar grid showing worker allocations. | 2. Selecting slots sets available slots.
Interactive Buttons & Controls: - 'Add Schedule' button | - Shifts timeline checkboxes

Features & Scope: Technician list tracking completed jobs, ratings, active status, and online states.
UX/UI Design & Flows: 1. Row click slides out StaffDrawer showing employee verification flags. | 2. Clicking 'Invite Staff' opens InviteStaffDrawer to recruit new workers.
Interactive Buttons & Controls: - 'Invite Staff' button | - Search field input | - Row selection items

Features & Scope: Technician profiling detail tracking total completed bookings, commission wallets, schedule shifts, and ratings history.
UX/UI Design & Flows: 1. Overview maps performance line graphs. | 2. Main panel nests lists of jobs, and week calendars. Actions pane enables commission splits updates.
Interactive Buttons & Controls: - 'Edit Commission Split' action button & input field | - 'Deactivate Employee' red button | - 'Save shifts settings' button

Features & Scope: Displays service catalog settings containing Basic, Standard, and Premium matrices splits.
UX/UI Design & Flows: 1. Lists active services. | 2. Row click opens ServiceDrawer to edit pricing split details, checklist templates, and package descriptions.
Interactive Buttons & Controls: - 'Add Service' button | - Search bar | - Row click items

Features & Scope: Tracks CRM statistics showing customer jobs totals, dates, and active statuses.
UX/UI Design & Flows: 1. Renders customer lists. | 2. Row click opens CustomerDrawer containing profile logs and message actions.
Interactive Buttons & Controls: - Search field | - Row selection items

Features & Scope: Star ratings feedback details list from customers.
UX/UI Design & Flows: 1. Renders star reviews log. | 2. Row click opens ReviewDrawer to review full comments details.
Interactive Buttons & Controls: - Star filter select dropdown | - Row selection items

Features & Scope: Lists dispute claims filed against company bookings.
UX/UI Design & Flows: 1. Row click redirects to disputes/[id] details mediation screen.
Interactive Buttons & Controls: - Search input | - Filters dropdown

Features & Scope: Dispute mediation counter-proof submission console. Lets companies upload before/after photos and check-in evidence.
UX/UI Design & Flows: 1. Left panel displays client dispute text claims. | 2. Right panel maps files drop zones to upload before/after job photos and submit evidence to platform admins.
Interactive Buttons & Controls: - 'Upload Proof file' drag zone | - 'Submit Counter-Evidence' action button | - 'Add Dispute Notes' textarea field

Features & Scope: Configures geographic bounds circles for matching coverage areas on web.
UX/UI Design & Flows: 1. Renders Leaflet Map showing bounds. | 2. Drawing tool draws boundaries shapes. | 3. Saving updates radius constraints.
Interactive Buttons & Controls: - Map drawing toggles | - 'Save Boundary' button

Features & Scope: Configure surge pricing modifiers, seasonal discounts, and sponsored visibility slots bids.
UX/UI Design & Flows: 1. Merchant defines surge time range. | 2. Submitting saves surge modifiers rules.
Interactive Buttons & Controls: - 'Add Surge modifier' button | - Save adjustments

Features & Scope: Configure company pricing plans and SaaS package details.
UX/UI Design & Flows: 1. Merchant reviews package comparison matrix plans. | 2. Clicks select plan to renew or edit details.
Interactive Buttons & Controls: - 'Renew/Edit packages' link

Features & Scope: Support tickets logger connecting merchant to ServiceFinder administration team.
UX/UI Design & Flows: 1. Merchant lists tickets. Clicking new open ticket drawer.
Interactive Buttons & Controls: - 'Submit Ticket' button

Features & Scope: Visualizes company ledger balances and processes KHQR cashout requests.
UX/UI Design & Flows: 1. Displays current balance metrics. | 2. Clicking 'Request Cashout' opens form to input withdrawal amount and upload bank QR image. Submitting registers transfer request.
Interactive Buttons & Controls: - 'Request Cashout' action button | - 'Upload KHQR Bank Code' file uploader | - Amount numerical field input | - Save bank credentials form

Features & Scope: Audit log showing credit/debit double-entry splits records.
UX/UI Design & Flows: 1. DataGrid lists logs. Filters query credit vs debit. | 2. Export CSV downloads logs summary.
Interactive Buttons & Controls: - 'Export CSV' button | - Type selector filters

Features & Scope: Plots visual summaries of revenue distributions, payouts history cycles, and peak performance charts.
UX/UI Design & Flows: 1. Charts render monthly distributions. | 2. Changing parameters triggers graphs refresh.
Interactive Buttons & Controls: - Date filters | - Export button

Features & Scope: Splits calculations detailing platform fees and staff commissions percentages configuration.
UX/UI Design & Flows: 1. Lists active rules tables. | 2. Edit rule triggers changes popup config.
Interactive Buttons & Controls: - 'Edit Rule' action button | - Save commission parameters settings

Features & Scope: Details of processed withdrawals logs.
UX/UI Design & Flows: 1. Lists payouts. Displays status (Pending, Paid, Failed).
Interactive Buttons & Controls: - Search query input | - Filter options

Features & Scope: Configure logo, cover, business hours, and mapping pins coordinates.
UX/UI Design & Flows: 1. Renders profile settings. Inputs take company details. | 2. Save profile updates database credentials.
Interactive Buttons & Controls: - 'Save Profile' button | - Logo / Cover upload fields | - Address map pin parser selector
